data.name: Sufan
data.long_meaning: Originating from the Arabic language, Sufan is a name that signifies grace, elegance, and softness. It is derived from the word 'Suf' which means wool in Arabic and is used to refer to the soft and gentle nature of the fabric.
data.spiritual_meaning: Sufan is a name that represents the inner softness and grace of a person. It signifies the gentle and compassionate qualities of a person and is believed to bring a sense of peace and tranquility to their life.
data.numerology_meaning: The name Sufan carries a 6 Life Path number, which indicates that the person is loving, nurturing, and caring. They are known for their ability to solve problems and adapt to new situations with ease.

The name may also be associated with the Sufi tradition of Islam, a mystical form of practice that emphasizes a deep connection with Allah through love, devotion, and inner transformation.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, Sufan can be seen as a reminder of the softness and gentleness that we should cultivate in our hearts towards Allah and towards others. The name evokes the image of a soft, comfortable woolen garment, and as such, it reminds us to treat ourselves and others with the same care, comfort, and tenderness.

historical_references.reference: Sufian ibn Abd al-Malik was a Umayyad prince who served as the governor of Egypt from 734 to 738 CE. He is known for his extensive building projects in Fustat, the ancient capital of Egypt, which included the construction of the Mosque of Amr Ibn Al-As and several palaces.

Sufyan al-Thawri was a prominent Sufi scholar and teacher from the 8th century CE. He is considered a founder of the Shadhiliyya Sufi order and is known for his emphasis on the importance of self-discipline and personal devotion in the Sufi path.
